decision_reason: Browser zoom exposed a mismatch between fixed-pixel clip-path coordinates and the View Transition snapshot coordinate space; the origin and reveal radius must be expressed relative to the viewport.

causal_assessment.hypothesis: fixed-pixel clip-path coordinates are affected by browser zoom in the View Transition snapshot
causal_assessment.supporting_evidence: user reproduced the offset at normal zoom and reported alignment at 67% zoom; browser validation showed the button maps to 80.625% and 5.23148% of the viewport
causal_assessment.falsifier: a sampled transition still reports a pixel-based origin or an origin percentage different from the trigger percentage

control_action.target: zoom-independent circular reveal from the mode trigger center

residual_risk: older browsers without View Transitions use the clip-path fallback
